g.title: CaptureProcess
g.text: Current capture, source preparation, storage, and recovery

g.title: cluster_start
g.text: 1. Start, recover saved work, and select an activity

g.title: cluster_capture
g.text: 2. Capture the activity and interact with Math Academy

g.title: Accounts
g.text: Each owns its browser, lock, checkpoints, and solver sessions

a.xlink:title: saved_imports.py: skip legacy captures; pause sweeps during unfinished assessment/diagnostic; retain exact pending intents
a.text: Startup + final sweeps; max 20 per sweep
Skip in capture-only / dry-run; unchanged failures wait

g.title: ResumeRead
g.text: Reopen saved activity and inspect actual state
Reuse solved answers; match shuffled choices by value
Observe existing grades before any further submission

g.title: Queue
g.text: Task type, IDs, availability, test requirements
Exclude captured tasks; recognize fresh reassigned lessons

g.title: Priorities
g.text: prerequisite graph + latest account progress snapshot

g.title: Select
g.text: -> optional quiz when other eligible work is exhausted

g.title: Dispatch
g.text: Start or resume the selected activity
Save task identity, policy, and checkpoint

a.xlink:title:
LESSON
Tutorial HTML, canonical Examples,
Knowledge points, practice Questions
CWCWC / WCWCC; perfect-retake override
REVIEW\nServed Questions and source KP links\nCWCWC / WCWCC; perfect-retake override
a.text: Served Questions and source KP links

a.xlink:title:
MULTISTEP
Initial shared context + ordered parts
Keep each part's original local problem
Aim for correct answers
a.text: Keep each part's original local problem

a.xlink:title:
ASSESSMENT / QUIZ
Instructions, fixed question set, time limit
Fill all Questions before whole-test submission
Aim for correct answers; saved pacing plan
a.text: Instructions, fixed question set, time limit
Fill all Questions before whole-test submission
Aim for correct answers; saved pacing plan

a.xlink:title:
DIAGNOSTIC
Instructions + frozen answer/skip policy
Adaptive question slots; classify covered skills
History later resolves source Question IDs
a.text: Adaptive question slots; classify covered skills
History later resolves source Question IDs

g.title: Before
g.text: Capture original Question + Answer fields + Answers
radio / select / blank; original choices and field positions
DOM/HTML, formulas, graphics, calculator instructions, screenshot

g.title: Solve
g.text: One persistent solver session per activity
Use captured examples/context and original choices
Choose response under the activity's answer policy
Save predictions and reasoning separately from source evidence

g.title: Enter
g.text: Enter and verify the actual visible response
Check selected option or typed value; save entered screenshot
Checkpoint before submission; observe pacing budget

g.title: After
g.text: Capture available MA grade, worked solution,

g.title: Interpret
g.text: Save solver interpretation and disagreement evidence

g.title: Continue
g.text: Continue / next question / next proof stage
Staged proofs retain accepted fields and stage evidence

g.title: FillTest
g.text: Continue filling until the fixed set is complete

g.title: SubmitTest
g.text: Checkpoint -> submit whole test -> confirm once
Per-question grades and solutions come from history

g.title: Terminal
g.text: Final screen / analysis, counts, outcome, and screenshots

g.title: Progress
g.text: Discover account's course scopes; read progress pages
Save displayed topic colors + differences in knowledge-state/

g.title: History
g.text: Join source Question IDs, topic/KP/example references,
difficulty, grades, and expanded worked solutions
Check history against the questions actually captured

g.title: TopicPage
g.text: Read the complete source lesson, including unvisited sections
Capture every tutorial/example placement and its graphics

g.title: Content
g.text: Original Questions, Examples, Tutorials and structure evidence
Journal capture completion separately from database import

g.title: QueueAfter
g.text: Refresh and save the next queue observation
Even after the last activity allowed by --limit

g.title: Evidence
g.text: assets/ + manifest: original bytes, URLs, hashes

g.title: Observations
g.text: These do not become learner / engine facts

g.title: CaptureOnly
g.text: Skip EDB previews, commits, and saved-import sweeps

a.xlink:title:
Rebuild from original MA evidence
Restore source prompt and worked solution
Rebuild original Answer fields / choices
Keep solver interpretations out of source content
a.text: Restore source prompt and worked solution
Keep solver interpretations out of source content

g.title: Keys
g.text: Displayed history key -> explicit DOM key
-> correct field grade / explicit single-field conclusion

g.title: Notes
g.text: Preserve MA originals, including source errors

a.xlink:title:
Prepare all content images
Validate bytes / SVG -> SHA-256 -> reuse or atomic copy
Rewrite prompts, solutions, tutorial/context content,
image choices AND matching correct_value
a.text: Validate bytes / SVG -> SHA-256 -> reuse or atomic copy

g.title: Snapshot
g.text: Read one current math database basis
Resolve Topic and Knowledge point identities
Compare existing Question, Tutorial, Step, and Activity records

g.title: Questions
g.text: Question + Answer field + Answer + KP membership
Changed fields get new definitions; retain old entities

g.title: LessonStructure
g.text: Activity -> ordered Steps -> Tutorial or Knowledge point
Knowledge point -> canonical Example + practice Questions
Compare source placements; preserve UUIDs; update first/next links

g.title: MultiStructure
g.text: Preserve part order and source-local problems; require all parts

g.title: OtherContent
g.text: Prepare reusable Questions and KP membership
Their attempt order, instructions, and routing remain evidence

a.xlink:title: Build transaction.edn + exact replacement guards\nSource: :org/Math-Academy\nContent facts only; retain immutable history
a.text: Content facts only; retain immutable history

g.title: SavedRetry
g.text: Pending intent: exact request / receipt recovery (5)
Reuse frozen payload, basis, and request key
Preview leaves an unresolved intent deferred

g.title: Preview
g.text: EDB with: preview against expected basis
Check MA attribution, allowed content attributes,
exact retractions, and immutable Answer/Answer-field definitions

g.title: PreviewOnly
g.text: Save preview and return without an EDB commit
The MA activity has still been performed

g.title: Intent
g.text: Persist exact commit intent BEFORE writing
Database, source, basis, payload hashes, and request key

g.title: Verify
g.text: Verify committed receipt at its database basis
Every changed fact attributed to Math Academy
Read back and replan: reimport must make no changes

g.title: Receipts
g.text: EDN / preview / exact intent / commit.edn / verification.json
Legacy edb-import/ receipts belong to the old database

g.title: Complete
g.text: Mark import complete only after verification
Capture completion remains a separate checkpoint

g.title: Next
g.text: Pace / cooldown; run eligible capture maintenance
Select next work, or final saved-import sweep and exit

g.title: Held
g.text: Defer this activity's import; retain all evidence
Any unresolved practice key holds the whole live import
Missing images / ambiguous identities also stop preparation

g.title: Reviewed
g.text: Inspect saved HTML and bind worked-solution answers to fields
Use original image-choice -a-1 evidence where applicable
Prepare verified-question batches; transact when requested
Broader recovery is not wired into the live preparer

g.title: Stale
g.text: Archive rejected plan; bounded replan (up to 3 attempts)

g.title: Unknown
g.text: Keep original intent; recover receipt or retry exact request

g.title: Fault
g.text: Save checkpoint, DOM, screenshot, traceback, and diagnostics

g.title: Repair
g.text: Read-only diagnosis -> isolated patch + regression/offline tests
Install tested change under shared lock
Restart worker with saved checkpoint, RNG, and counters

g.title: Stop
g.text: Save checkpoint and stop this worker

g.title: ReviewRoute
g.text: Then matching, preview, and requested commit

g.title: Legend
g.text: Dotted arrows: evidence or supporting input
Purple dashed arrows: separate reviewed recovery
Green: shared image storage / verified outcomes
